title: Hand-Drawn 3D Look — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Hand-Drawn 3D Look's rich face: three walks that test the page's claims on BLUELINE's own plates (the seam's redraw, the line's four knobs, the boil), the proofs gathered beside the sections they serve, and the findings held as offers for Loudon. I grow when the page is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.file: Hand-Drawn 3D Look — rich — one config away.html
pieces.title: one config away · five steps
pieces.near: Same scene, opposite feeling, one config away
pieces.caption: **One config away.** BLUELINE's city street rendered seventeen times, each in a fresh Blender 5.1.2: one plain line, then four knobs (chaining, noise, smoothing, and a pen knob that also moves base thickness and crease angle) at sixteen corners, two of them the catalogue's tentative #1 and confident #9. It walks from one line to the knobs, and last measures which knob moves the marks the page names. Noise carries the searching line; SKETCHY doubles the ink only with heavy noise behind it; Bézier smoothing barely moves it and on a noisy sketchy chain throws spears. The feeling is yours to judge.

pieces.title: Freestyle against Grease Pencil · BLUELINE
pieces.near: Pick by whether the frame holds still or moves
pieces.caption: The same scene three ways. Left, Freestyle's confident #9; centre and right, Grease Pencil Line Art at its confident and heavy settings, drawn over holdout geometry so the strokes sit on white. Grease Pencil's line is thinner and evener; Freestyle's thickens at silhouettes and with nearness. BLUELINE, 2026-06-25.

sections.heading: The seam is a redraw, not a filter

pieces.file: Hand-Drawn 3D Look — rich — the seam is a redraw.html
pieces.title: where the render becomes a drawing · five steps
pieces.caption: **Where the render becomes a drawing.** BLUELINE's own seam proofs, measured: the plate alone, one timid redraw (0.72: 1.8 % of pixels change), the ladder to 0.95, then the test. At 0.95 with Canny at 0.42, 44 % of the drawing's edges are new and 91 % of the plate's edges are still held (chance: 60 %). Last, eight seeds: the corridor's outline holds in every one (in two only as faint edges), but how much of the plate's structure holds runs from barely above chance to nearly all of it.

pieces.title: the figure under the redraw · BLUELINE
pieces.near: The redraw survives on a figure
pieces.caption: Four ways to anchor a posed figure through the redraw. A, Canny alone at 0.95; B, Canny and depth at 0.95; C, Canny and OpenPose at 0.95; D2, Canny 0.30, depth 0.60 and OpenPose 0.70, the one that holds both pose and ink. D2 ran at denoise 0.93, not 0.95 (the proof's report, and its script). One seed, one pose. BLUELINE, 2026-06-25.

pieces.title: the boil, measured · five steps
pieces.caption: **The boil, measured.** BLUELINE's smoke plume rendered again, each job in a fresh Blender: one frame, twelve frames, the page's boil on twos (real and exact: each new seed redraws about a quarter of the line, 0.6 % of the frame; in the clip it is swamped), the boil nobody set (Freestyle's Spatial Noise draws fresh on every render in a session: 3.1 %, on ones), and last the playhead test. Frame 5 rendered alone differs from frame 5 in the run; with Spatial Noise off they match exactly.

offers.section: The seam is a redraw, not a filter
offers.what: "Variation across seeds is high ... while the structure stays locked" is half true. Across the eight seeds the corridor (walls, ground line, vanishing point) holds in every one, but the plate's edges held run 55 % to 93 % (above chance 0.26 to 0.83), and three seeds (88, 55555, 70707) are under halfway above chance. Suggest: "the corridor stays locked; the structure inside it does not always."

offers.section: The seam is a redraw, not a filter
offers.what: The low rung was denoise 0.72 with Canny held at 0.85 and ending at 85 % of the schedule (02_stylize.py), and every rung changed more than denoise: Canny (0.85, 0.55, 0.42), the prompt, cfg (6.5 vs 7.5), steps (24 vs 26) and seed. Suggest naming the tight Canny on the low rung. Each rung is one seed, and at the 0.95 recipe the seeds alone swing new marks 13-57 %, so the proofs can't place the turn more exactly.

offers.section: The seam is a redraw, not a filter
offers.what: "A figure holds its authored pose all the way to denoise 0.95": run B (Canny plus depth, 0.95) held the pose but lost the ink (redraw-posed-figure/report.md:51, 78); the stack that holds both pose and ink, D2, ran at 0.93 (report.md:37; 04_redraw_D_depth_freestyle.py:124), on one seed and one pose (report.md:86). Suggest: "the recipe ran at 0.93; depth alone held the pose to 0.95 at the cost of the ink".

Which knob does the work, measured on sixteen fresh renders: noise moves ink off the edge most (-15.6 points on average, chaining -5.7, Bézier +3.0); SKETCHY chaining doubles the ink only with heavy noise behind it (1.75x heavy, 1.27x trace); Bézier smoothing barely moves the marks and, on a SKETCHY heavy-noise chain, throws long spears (6.7 % to 8.5 % of the ink more than 12 px off). The tentative #1 already carries a calligraphy pen (0.6 to 4.5 at 45 degrees), so thin-to-thick is in both. "One config away" is one line-style block of ten values. Suggest: tentative = SKETCHY and heavy noise together; confident = PLAIN and a trace of noise, with the wider pen for weight.

"Fully deterministic" needs a noise caveat: it holds from a fresh Blender, or with Spatial Noise off. Freestyle's Spatial Noise keeps state across renders in one Blender process (it survives read_factory_settings): the confident #9 rendered twice in one session differs on 5.6 % of pixels, today's fresh #9 against the catalogue's (rendered ninth in its session) on 5.3 %, while #1 and #2 match theirs pixel for pixel. With Spatial Noise at 0, repeated renders match exactly.

The boil the page names is real and exact, and in the clip it is swamped. Re-seeding the Perlin noise on twos redraws 26-33 % of the plume's ink area per new seed (0.6 % of the frame; the ink is 2.2 % of it), and nothing on the frames between. But Spatial Noise already redraws the line on every render, a boil on ones (3.1 % of the frame, 4.9x), so with the handler off the clip still changes 4.16 % per frame (on: 4.17 %), and the change doesn't alternate. Suggest: "the waver here comes mostly from Spatial Noise redrawing on every render; the Perlin re-seed on twos is real but swamped."

"Every frame is a pure function of the playhead" needs the same noise caveat. Geometry and value are a function of the frame, so the elements still sync to the song, and two whole runs from a fresh Blender match byte for byte. The line is not: frame 5 rendered alone differs from frame 5 in the twelve-frame run on 2.64 % of pixels (full size). Fix, tested: Spatial Noise amplitude 0, keeping the Perlin boil seeded from the frame, and frame 5 alone matches the run exactly. This is also why today's renders differ from June's (smoke was rendered third in its session).
